name: one-hour-block-hourly-spacing
rationale: Mandatory cost-targeting hypothesis under the warning rule (baseline sharpe_minus_static_mix negative for the tenth consecutive run on 2026-09-28: -0.0029 at 50,000 JPY where the baseline degenerated to 1 trade, -23.88 at 500,000 JPY with fee_drag_pct 5.85 vs total_return_pct -10.67). The block/spacing grid measured so far is 1800/3600 (2026-09-22, +1.51 Sharpe @500k), 7200/3600 (2026-09-28, +2.44 @500k) and 7200/7200 (2026-09-25, +3.00 @500k; best measured at 50,000 JPY but rejected on trade count 11/81). The diagonal point 3600/3600 is the only untested cell between them: a one-hour signal hold matched to hourly action spacing, which should keep more rebalances than 7200/7200 (to clear the 50% trade-count bar at 50,000 JPY) while still cutting signal churn. Direction at 50,000 JPY is uncertain because of the lot-floor accumulation effect documented on 2026-09-21; report per capital and score on total_fees_jpy plus the promotion rule, never on trade count.
